bulletin.title: Mystery Booster Commander Edition Update Bulletin

functional_changes.subject: rulebreaker Commander abilities
functional_changes.source_summary: A rulebreaker ability applies before the game when its card is the player's commander.
functional_changes.engineering_action: Do not issue a definitive negative color-identity/deck-inclusion result when a designated commander has an unmodelled rulebreaker exception.

functional_changes.subject: meld card classification
functional_changes.source_summary: Meld cards no longer count as double-faced cards; a card referring to double-faced cards, such as Overgrown Pest, no longer includes meld cards.
functional_changes.engineering_action: Rules/keyword answers based on the 2026-09-25 701/702/712 excerpts are explicitly dated; do not assert current DFC/meld semantics from them.

functional_changes.subject: Tolabow, Loch Rascal Oracle wording
functional_changes.source_summary: The printed rulebreaker wording was replaced with explicit instant/sorcery color-identity and basic-land exemptions.
functional_changes.engineering_action: Treat the Oracle update as independently sourced; do not infer universal rulebreaker exceptions from Tolabow.

limits: The October 19 bulletin calls these planned changes and explicitly defers to the official published Comprehensive Rules in case of discrepancy.
The Wizards rules landing page still linked to the September 25 TXT at the November 1 observation; there is no independently verified newer CR TXT SHA-256 to replace the verbatim excerpts.
This audit does not certify a current-rule rules engine or gameplay simulation.
